subject: Renewal QBR: timeboxed roadmap walkthrough & exec slot request
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@synergetix.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Chris Taylor <ctaylor@synergetix.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo - May renewal window

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well. Our subscription for Redwood is up for renewal in mid-May and we’d like to schedule a QBR + roadmap walkthrough focused on expansion opportunities (ML inference at scale, routing rules, and dedicated capacity). Goal is to align product roadmap with our expansion asks and get an internal decision by May 10.

We’re looking for a 60-minute session that covers: 1) product roadmap & upcoming features, 2) migration/ops implications, 3) pricing/packaging impact and next steps. Preferably the session includes a 15-minute executive-only pre-brief with our CTO and Redwood execs.

Possible windows (London/UTC+1):
 - Tue May 4, 09:00–10:00
 - Tue May 4, 15:00–16:00
 - Wed May 5, 11:00–12:00

Attendees from our side will be me (SaaS Lead) and Chris (IT lead) plus CTO if available — I’ll confirm exact list once we lock time.

Can you propose availability and an agenda? We may need a short SOW/update to circulate to procurement before the meeting.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Cloud Ops | Synergetix
priya@synergetix.com

--
Attachment: none (we can send attendee list once time is confirmed)

Hi Priya — great timing, thanks for the heads up. Happy to run the QBR + roadmap walkthrough.

I’m proposing these concrete slots (London / UTC+1) to match what you suggested:
 - Tue May 4, 09:00–10:00 (primary)
 - Tue May 4, 15:00–16:00 (alternate)
 - Wed May 5, 11:00–12:00 (backup)

Proposed structure (60m):
 0–15m: exec-only pre-brief (CTO + Redwood execs)
 15–40m: roadmap & upcoming features (product lead)
 40–55m: ops/architecture run-through (tech lead)
 55–60m: next steps / procurement checklist (account lead)

I’ve attached a short proposed agenda (proposed-qbr-agenda.pdf) and a light checklist for procurement. Can you confirm who will join from your side (names + titles) and whether legal/procurement will need to sit in? Also flag any focus areas you want the product team to prep (e.g., quantization/latency profiles, dedicated pools, SSO/pass-through).

If you confirm the May 4 09:00 slot I’ll send a calendar invite and a pre-read deck. We can also carve out a 15-minute exec-only pre-brief directly before the main session if that helps.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
